title: Lsn Cases
description: Tired of the old boring way of opening scrolls ? This mod will add a cool csgo animation to enchant scrolls on lifesteal.net !!
body:
**This is a mod for lifesteal.net server**

Tired of the same old boring enchant scroll openings on Lifesteal.net?
This mod completely transforms the experience by replacing the standard instant-open mechanic with a smooth, exciting, and immersive animation system that makes every scroll feel rewarding.

Instead of simply clicking a scroll and instantly seeing the result, you'll now get a cinematic-style reveal that builds suspense and excitement — making rare enchants feel truly special.


**HOW TO USE IT ?**

To use this mod you just need to download it alongside mod menu and fabric api and then join lifesteal.net (the server its made for , and it wont do anything in other servers) and open your enchant scrolls . :D
